t: Din chittim shennapal alehem mayim vetabshil shennimtza betoko chitta
s: Din chittim shennapal alehem mayim vetabshil shennimtza betoko chitta ubo s"h seipim: kebar nitbaer besiman tn"g shemmiddin haggemara muttar liltot et hachittim, shekkol zeman shebbolel otam bemayim enan baim lide chimmutz min hassetam kol zeman shello nitbaqqeu, sheeseq habbelila min hassetam hu monea otan millehachmitz. Abal im roeh otan shennitbaqqeu bishat halletita — hare hen asurot min hattora, shehabbiqqua hu siman shehen qerobot lehachmitz, ubevadday yachmitzu tekep umiyyad chimmutz gamur shechayyabin alayv karet:

Abal leachar gemar halletita sheshshub eno oseq bahen beyadayim, im hen shohin bammayim shiur mil — yekolin hen labo lide chimmutz gamur belo biqqua, ulepikak hen asurot min hattora missapeq, shemma kebar hechmitzu. Veken kol dagan shennapelu alayv mayim apillu muatim, vaapillu hayu geshamim mezallepin alayv zelipa muetet, im shaha lachluchit hammayim alayv shiur mil, ap al pi shello nitrakkek bammayim ella hu qasheh kemo shehaya — hare zeh asur apillu lehashhoto ad leachar happesach apillu shello nitbaqqea. Ella mokero meat meat lenokrim, beinyan sheyyesh litlot sheyyokluhu hannokrim qodem happesach, abal lo yimkor mimmennu harbeh lenokri echad, gezera shemma yachazor hannokri veyimkerennu o yittenennu leyisrael acher sheeno yodea shennapelu alayv mayim veyoklennu hayyisrael bepesach, mah sheen ken keshemmokero meat meat yesh kan b' sepeqot lehaqel: shemma yoklennu hannokri beatzmo velo yimkor veyitten mimmennu leyisrael, veap im yachazor hannokri veyimkor hamat hazzeh leyisrael acher — yesh litlot sheyyokal hayyisrael kol hamat hazzeh qodem happesach:

Veim rotzeh lemokro leyisrael, apillu mokero meat meat — tzarik hu lehodia lehaqqonim shennapelu alayv mayim velo yokluhu bepesach, sheim lo yodiem yesh lachosh shemma yeshayyer echad mehem mehamat hazzeh leekol mimmennu bepesach. Abal keshemmodia lehaqqonim shennapelu alayv mayim — yakol limkor apillu harbeh leadam echad, veen chosheshin shemma yishkach halloqeach mah shehodio hammoker veyokal mimmenna bepesach:

Vekol zeh bedagan shello nitbaqqea sheen chimmutzo nikkar, abal im nitbaqqea shechimmutzo nikkar — yakol limkor apillu harbeh lenokri echad. Veen chosheshim shemma yitchanem hannokri velo yihyeh chimmutzam nikkar veachar kak yimkor mehaqqemach leyisrael veyoklenna bepesach, lepi shekkebar aseru leyisrael shello liqqach minnokri qemach lepesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"g. Veyesh oserin limkor harbeh lenokri echad, shechosheshin shemma yitchanem hannokri velo yehe chimmutzam nikkar veyimkor haqqemach leyisrael veyashheh hayyisrael et haqqemach ad leachar happesach veyaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem im en sham hepsed merubbeh. Abal im yesh sham hepsed merubbeh, kegon mi sheyyesh lo beereb pesach dagan harbeh shennitbaqqea shei epshar lo lemokro leyisrael, sheen hayyisrael qoneh chametz harbeh beereb pesach — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, veyakol lemokro kullo lenokri echad (shehare ap im yitchano hannokri veyimkor haqqemach leyisrael achar zeman issur chametz — lo yaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh", lepi shehu meqach taut, sheillu haya yodea shehaqqemach hu middagan shennapelu alayv mayim — lo haya loqecho, shemmin hassetam en noach leadam liqnot dabar haasur lo liqnoto kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"ch. Veim yimkerennu leyisrael qodem zeman issur chametz gam ken — lo yaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" min hattora, shehare nahagu kol yisrael lebattel besop shaa h' kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"d. Veod, sheyyesh omerim sheen adam ober be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" ella al chametzo hayyadua lo abal lo al chametzo sheen yadua lo, veqemach zeh en halloqecho yodea shehu chametz). Abal im lo nitbaqqea — lo yimkerennu lenokri mekira chaluta, ella yimkerennu lenokri hammakkiro shehu yodea bo shello yigga bachametzo ella yishmerennu lo ad leachar happesach veyachazirennu lo ukemo shennitbaer besiman tm"ch, o yebaqqesh minnokri acher sheyyiqqach sheveh maneh bematayim veyabtiach lo sheyyachazor veyiqqach mimmennu leachar happesach veyitten lo revach kemo shennitbaer sham, shemmeatta en lachosh shemma yimkerennu hannokri leyisrael acher, shebbevadday lo yapsid hannokri maotayv. Mikkol maqom, en lismok al hetterim hallalu ella im ken yesh sham hepsed merubbeh:

Vekol zeh kesheshshaha lachluchit hammayim al haddagan shiur mil, abal qodem laken, apillu dagan harbeh shennishra bammayim betok happesach — yakol lemokro kullo lenokri echad qodem sheyyishheh shiur mil, sheadayin lo nitchammetz umuttar bahanaa:

Yisrael shellaqach chittim minnokri veachar kak haya hannokri mesiach lepi tummo sherachatz hachittim bemayim — hare hen muttarot, sheen hannokri neeman bazeh sheamar leachar shemmekaram veyatzeu mittachat yado. Abal im amar ken bishat hammeker beodan beyado — neeman apillu lo haya mesiach lepi tummo. Veim hannokri hu muchzaq leneeman beenayv, ap im amar ken leachar shemmekaran — asurin ap al pi shello haya mesiach lepi tummo:

Dagan shennitba bannahar veshaha sham shiur mil o yoter, ap al pi shennitrakkek bammayim veqarob lehitbaqqea — eno chametz vadday ella sapeq. Lepikak, im nitnaggeb venityabbesh venitareb bedagan acher harbeh mimmennu, apillu nitareb betok happesach — yesh mattirin hattaarobet apillu baakila, shehare bekol issure tora yabesh shennitareb beyabesh batel berob, ella shebbechametz bepesach hechemiru chakamim leesor bemashshehu, velo hechemiru ella bechametz vadday abal lo bispeq chametz. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veoserin im kebar haya merukkak qodem shennitareb. Veken hamminhag bimdinot ellu kemo she[yi]tebbaer. Umikkol maqom, bimqom hepsed merubbeh, kegon shei epshar lo limtzo nokri lemokro lo chutz middeme issur shebbo (kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z) — yesh lismok al sebara harishona lehattir lehashhot hattaarobet ad leachar happesach apillu naasa hattaarobet betok happesach. Abal im en sham hepsed merubbeh — en lehaqel apillu naasa qodem happesach, ella yaaseh kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b vetan"g bedagan shennitchammetz chimmutz gamur veachar kak nitareb, ayyen sham:

Dagan shehaya munnach baaliyya veyaredu geshamim derek haggag letok haaliyya venitlachlechu miqtzat hachittim — otan shennitlachlechu asur apillu lehashhotan, vehashshear ap al pi sheyyesh lehistappeq bahen shemma yaredu alehem geshamim veachar kak nitnaggebu — ap al pi ken hen muttarot apillu baakila mikkoach sepeq sepeqa: shemma lo yaredu alehem geshamim, veim timtza lomar yaredu, shemma lo nitchammetzu. Umikkol maqom, im epshar lo beqal limtzo chittim acherim lepesach — en lo lismok al hassepeq sepeqa leekol mehem bepesach, ella yashheh otam ad leachar happesach, meachar sheen lo hepsed bishhiyyatan:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheraa shennitlachlechu miqtzat hachittim shebbaaliyya, sheyyesh lachosh shemma nitlachlechu gam hashshear veachar kak nitnaggebu. Abal im lo nitlachlechu baaliyya, ap al pi sheyyesh bahen harbeh mebuqqaot shennitbaqqeu beodan baggadish mechamat haggeshamim sheyyaredu alehem, mikkol maqom hashshear shello nitbaqqeu muttarot apillu baakila, lepi shehaddabar matzuy shebbishat haggeshamim elyonot haggadish vetachtonot mitchammetz umitbaqqea veen hammayim nogein beemtzaito kelal:

Shana sherabbu bo haggeshamim veyaredu al haaremot shebbassadot ad sheqqetzat mehashshibbolim sheal haaremot hayu maalin tzemachim — ap al pi ken en chosheshin listam chittim shel otah hashshana kol sheen roin bahem siman chimmutz, lepi sheanu holekin achar harob veen harob machmitzin. Veap otam aremot sherainu shennapelu alehem geshamim — tolin lehaqel, shemma lo niknesu haggeshamim ella bashshibbolim haelyonim abal lo bebeten haarema, veim timtza lomar niknesu, shemma lo hispiqu lehachmitz:

Chittim shebbau bispina, im hem yebeshot veqashot velo nishtannu maritan — en machaziqin bahen issur missapeq lomar: shemma bau bammayim veachar kak nitnaggebu venityabbeshu. Abal im nishtanna maritan o shehen lachot, ap al pi shello nitrakkeku — asur apillu lehashhotan:
Dagan shemmechubbar laqqarqa, im nityabbesh legamre veen tzarik od linoq min haaretz — hare hu ketalush umunnach bekad, veyakol labo lide chimmutz im yeredu alayv geshamim:
Yisrael sheyyesh lo borot meleim chittim — nitbaer besiman tl"v, ayyen sham:

Nohagin bimdinot ellu shello leekol debash bepesach, shechosheshin shemma erebu bo qemach mechittim shennirchatzu bemayim qodem hattechina. Vaapillu debash shel yisrael sherada oto mikkavveret shello veyadua lo shello nitareb bo qemach — ap al pi ken en leoklo velo litteno letok hattabshil velo laasot mimmennu mashqeh me debash (sheqqorin ma"d) betok happesach, mippene marit haayin, sheenan yodein shehu shel yisrael. Abal qodem happesach, apillu debash shel nokri — muttar laasot mimmennu mashqeh me debash lishtoto bepesach, sheap im nitareb meat qemach betok haddebash — hare hu mitbattel beshishshim betok hammashqeh qodem happesach, veeno chozer veneor bepesach. Vaapillu debash bipne atzmo shebbishshelo qodem happesach — muttar leoklo bepesach, sheap im haya betoko meat chametz — hare hu nitbattel betoko beshishshim, kevan sheen bo ella chashash chimmutz. Veyesh mattirin apillu bepachot mishshishshim. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh o bimqom meniat simchat yom tob:

Vekol zeh bidbash shemmebiin bekelim qetannim, shekkebar hubdal min hashshaava, ulekak yesh lachosh shemma erebu bo qemach kede sheap haqqemach yithappek lidbash, shekken derek haddebash lehachazir et haddabar hannopel letoko ulehapeko lidbash. Abal debash shemmebiin bechabiyyot min hakkavveret sheadayin hu meorab betok hashshaava — en derek leareb bo qemach, ulekak muttar laasot mimmennu mashqeh betok happesach o leoklo beeno. Veyesh machamirin shello leoklo beeno, veshello laasot mimmennu mashqeh bepesach. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem shello leoklo beeno ella im ken nitbashshel qodem happesach. Abal laasot mimmennu mashqeh, hammeqel bimdinot ellu sheen lanu shetiyya acheret bepesach — lo hipsid, veshebach kebod yom tob beyado:

Vekol zeh bistam meqomot, abal bimqomot sheyyadua beberur sheen derek leareb baddebash shum qemach — yesh lehattir sham apillu haddebash shehubdal mehashshaava ap leoklo beeno. Ubimqomot sheyyadua shedderek hannokrim leareb harbeh qemach baddebash ad sheyyesh lachosh baddebash shehubdal mehashshaava shemma erebo bo kol kak qemach ad sheen behaddebash shishshim kenegdo — en laasot mimmennu mashqeh apillu qodem happesach. Abal muttar lehashhoto ad leachar happesach. Veim napal letok hattabshil bepesach — hare hu mitbattel apillu bepachot mishshishshim im yesh sham hepsed merubbeh o meniat simchat yom tob, lepi sheyyesh lismok al haomerim shekkol issur shennopel letok haddebash venithappek lihyot debash nipqa issuro mimmennu vahare hu hetter gamur. Umikkol maqom, en lismok al sebara zo lehaqel ella kesheen yadua beberur sheerebu qemach chametz bidbash zeh sherotzeh lehashhoto, o bidbash zeh shennapal mimmennu letok hattabshil, sheyyesh bidbash zeh harbeh tzedadim lehaqel belo sebara zo, shemma lo erebu bo qemach kelal, veim timtza lomar erebu, shemma haqqemach hu mechittim shello nirchatzu, veim timtza lomar nirchatzu, shemma lo nitchammetzu, sheap sheshshahu hachittim harbeh bemayim enan chametz vadday ella sapeq kemo shennitbaer lemala. Abal im yadua beberur sheerebu qemach chametz (ayyen siman tn"g) ap shennithappek lidbash — asur lehashhoto. Veim napal letok hattabshil — oser taarobto bemashshehu ap bimqom hepsed merubbeh umeniat simchat yom tob:

Nohagin bimdinot ellu shello leekol bepesach ad yom tob haacharon shel galuyyot kol mine gerogarot vetzimmuqin ushear kol happerot shennityabbeshu, lepi shedderek lepazzer qemach al haggerogarot beshaa shemmeyabbeshin otan, vehatztzimmuqin regilin leorbam im haggerogarot beshaa shemmeyabbeshin otan, veken shear kol happerot haybeshim regilin lepazzer alehem qemach, vegam yesh shergilin leyabbesham betannur, upeamim shemmeyabbeshin bo leachar sheapu bo lechem chametz. Abal im yadua sheen bahem chashash chimmutz, kegon shennityabbeshu al yede yisrael venizhar bahem mechametz — en lehachamir bahem:

Vaapillu nityabbeshu beyad hannokri, im napelu letok hattabshil — enan oserin ap al pi sheen behattabshil shishshim kenegdam. Veap lekattechilla nohagin hetter biqtzat meqomot laasot mehem mashqeh bepesach, dehaynu sheshshorin otam bemayim ad shenniqlat taman betok hammayim veshotin hammayim bepesach, dekevan sheen bahem ella chashash beolma — en machamirin kol kak leesor ap me sheriyyatan. Abal en meqilin kol kak lebashshel otam bepesach kede lishtot me bishshulam bepesach, lepi sheal yede habbishshul niqlat tamam bammayim yoter meal yede sheriyya. Ubemiqtzat meqomot nohagin lehachamir beme sheriyyatan kemo beme bishshulan, ella im ken sheraan ubishshelan qodem happesach:

Hatztzuqer heasuy kekoba (sheqqorin hot tzoqar) — en bo chashash chametz, umuttar lehashhoto bepesach. Veap al pi ken nohagin lemokro lenokri qodem happesach. Ubediabad sheshshakach vehishha oto ad leachar happesach — muttar apillu baakila, vaapillu beyom tob haacharon shel galuyyot muttar leoklo. Veim nizkar betok happesach — yakol lemokro lenokri. Veim napal letok hattabshil — eno oser apillu bepachot mishshishshim:

Abal hatztzuqer hammebushshal hannechtak lachatikot (sheqqorin tzoqar qanadil), veken mine belilot tzuqer shemmechappin bahem mine perot ubesamim — yesh bahem chashash chimmutz, veen lehashhotam bepesach, veen leoklam apillu beyom tob haacharon. Umikkol maqom, im napelu letok hattabshil — enan oserin apillu bepachot mishshishshim im yesh sham hepsed merubbeh o meniat simchat yom tob. Veken im abar vehishha otam ad leachar happesach — yesh lehattiram bahanaa. Ubimqom hepsed merubbeh yesh lehattir apillu baakila, lepi sheyyesh kan harbeh tzedadim lehaqel: shemma lo erebu bahem qemach, veim timtza lomar erebu, shemma nitbattel bahem beshishshim, veim timtza lomar lo nitbattel, shemma haqqemach hu mechittim shello nirchatzu, veim timtza lomar nirchatzu shemma lo nitchammetzu. Veap sheyyesh lachosh shemma bishshelu hatztzuqer bekelim chamutzim, mikkol maqom hare yesh mattirin dabar shennitbashshel bikli chametz qodem happesach apillu leoklo bepesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z:

Nohagin bimdinot ellu shello leekol tzipporen (sheqqorin nagly"k) vekarkom (sheqqorin zapry"n), lepi shebbochashin qemach im mayim umezallepin al hakkarkom beshaa shemmeyabbeshin otam, vehatztzipporen shorin oto beme seorim qodem shemmeyabbeshin oto:

Veap karkom haggadel beginnat beto venizhar bo mechametz — nohagin bo issur, mippene marit haayin, shehakkarkom eno matzuy bimdinot ellu veyisberu shehu karkom habba mimmerchaqqim, mah sheen ken shear kol happerot shennityabbeshu al yede yisrael venizhar bahem mechametz sheen chosheshin bahem lemarit haayin, lepi shehem metzuyin vehakkol yodeim shellipamim meyabbeshin otam al yede yisrael:
Kelim hatztzebuim bekarkom nohagin shello lehishtammesh bahem bepesach. Vekarkom vetzipporen shennapelu letabshil enan oserin taarobtam apillu bepachot mishshishshim:
Hatab"q derek lishroto beshekar biqtzat meqomot — tzarik lesogro becheder o laasot mechitztza lepanayv. Veken hakkarkom bimqomot shennohagin bo issur:

Chitta o seora shennimtzet betabshil bepesach, im hi mebuqqaat mammash — kol hattabshil asur apillu bahanaa, shechametz bepesach bemashshehu. Abal im enah mebuqqaat mammash, ap al pi shennitrakkeka vehi qeroba lehitbaqqea — yesh mattirin hattabshil apillu baakila im yesh bo shishshim kenegdah, dekevan shello nitbaqqea adayin enah chametz vadday ella sapeq, velo hechemiru leesor bemashshehu ella bechametz vadday, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shekkol dagan shennitrakkek bemayim kol kak ad shehu rauy lehitbaqqea — hare zeh chametz vadday min hattora ap al pi shello nitbaqqea adayin, lepi shebbevadday yabo lide chimmutz tekep umiyyad. Ulepi sheakshav en anu beqiin mah niqra rauy lehitbaqqea, lepikak kol shennitrakkeka hachitta ap al pi shello nitbaqqea — neesar kol hattabshil apillu bahanaa. Veim nitareb mashshehu mittabshil zeh letabshilin acherim — kullam neesarim bahanaa. Vegam kol hakkelim sheshshimmeshu betabshilin ellu beodan chammin shehayyad soledet bo — tzarik lehatznian ad leachar happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z bechametz vadday, ayyen sham. Veken hamminhag pashut bimdinot ellu, veen leshannot. Umikkol maqom, im yesh sham hepsed merubbeh — yesh lismok al sebara harishona lehattir hattaarobet bahanaa, o lehashhoto ad achar happesach leachar sheyyasir mishsham et hachitta vibaarenna. Vekol zeh keshennapal letok hattabshil chitta o seora merukkeket, o shennitrakkeka betok hattabshil. Abal im lo nitrakkeka — enah oseret kelal et hattabshil apillu baakila:

Vaapillu chitta mebuqqaat shennimtzet betabshil, shehattabshil asur apillu bahanaa ledibre hakkol, mikkol maqom yakol lemokrah lenokri leachar shehesir hachitta mimmennu im hu chullo shel moed, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tm"z. Veyesh oserin. Veken hamminhag bimdinot ellu, veen leshannot ella bimqom hepsed merubbeh meod, kemo shennitbaer sham. Umikkol maqom, im en hachitta bequa — yesh lehattir limkor lenokri ap al pi sheen sham hepsed merubbeh meod. Abal im en sham hepsed merubbeh kelal — en lehaqel:

Kesherotzeh lemokro — tzarik lemokro tekep umiyyad shennoda hattaarobet, shehare asur lehashhoto bepesach mittaam shennitbaer sham. Veim hu shabbat o yom tob — yukal litteno lenokri bemattana ledibre hammattirin lemokro bechullo shel moed, shehare muttar litten mezonot lenokri beshabbat veyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besiman shk"h:

Veim abar vehishha otam ad shemini shel pesach, apillu hayeta hachitta bequa — yakol lehashhoto ad leachar happesach. Veen tzarik lomar im naasa hattaarobot beyom shemini shel pesach, sherashshay lehashhoto, veen tzarik litteno lenokri ledibre hammattirin, dekevan sheyyom shemini eno ella middibre soperim — lo hechemiru bo kol kak leesor lehashhot taarobet chametz mashshehu. Abal hechametz mashshehu atzmo — asur lehashhoto apillu beyom shemini, ella yaaseh kammishpat shennitbaer besiman tm"v, ayyen sham:

Ap al pi shechametz bepesach bemashshehu, mikkol maqom eno oser betzonen, kegon im nimtzet chitta bequa bepesach bemayim o beyayin tzonenim — hare hem muttarin im yadua shello shahata betokam meet leet, lepi shehatztzonen eno maplit umablia kelum, velo niplat min hachitta apillu mashshehu letok hayyayin o hammayim. Umikkol maqom, im nopla letokam perusat lechem o issa, apillu nopla qodem happesach vehesirah mishsham qodem happesach — asur lishtotam bepesach, ella im ken sinnenam qodem happesach, lepi shehallechem vehaissa asuyin lehitparer, veyesh lachosh shemma nisharu perurin betok hammayim vehayyayin (ayyen siman tm"z). Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shehatztzonen maplit umablia mashshehu, veim nimtzet chitta bequa bemayim sheshsharu bahem basar bepesach — habbasar asur, lepi shehammayim maplitin taam mashshehu min hachitta umabliin babbasar ap shello shaha betokam. Veen tzarik lomar shehammayim asurim, veim bishshel bah tabshil — hattabshil asur, vaapillu lo nitbaqqea hachitta ella shennitrakkeka bammayim hallalu shennopla letokam, o shennopla letokam keshehi merukkeket — hare hi keillu nitbaqqea lepi minhag medinot ellu, kemo shennitbaer:

Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Umikkol maqom, bemaqom shennahagu lehachamir — en leshannot, ella im ken yesh sham hepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq, sheaz yesh lehaqel apillu bechitta bequa. Veken im yesh sham od tzad echad lehaqel, kegon shennimtzet hachitta bammayim leachar shehesiru mishsham habbasar shennishra betokam, sheyyesh litlot velomar shekkol zeman shehabbasar haya sharuy bammayim lo hayeta sham chitta, veachar shehesiruhu mishsham nopla hachitta shamma — hare zeh muttar. Veken im natal mayim mimmayim [ellu] qodem shennimtzet bahem hachitta ubishshel bahem tabshil — hattabshil muttar apillu hayeta hachitta bequa:

Vaapillu mayim chammin shennimtzet bahen chitta, ap al pi shennitrakkeka ella sheenah bequa — yesh lehattir hattabshil shebbishshelu bahem qodem shemmatzeu bahem chitta, mikkoach sepeq sepeqa: shemma achar kak nopla shamma hachitta, veim timtza lomar qodem laken nopla, shemma lo nitrakkeka ad atta. Ubelo nitrakkeka — en leesor hattabshil apillu lepi minhagenu, kemo shennitbaer:

Abal chametz gamur, kegon lechem o issa o chitta bequa shennimtzeu bemayim chammim, apillu hem betok keli sheni — yesh leesor ap hattabshil shebbishshelu bah qodem shennimtza bahem hechametz. Vaapillu bimqom hepsed merubbeh umeniat simchat yom tob — en lehaqel. Veap lehashhoto asur. Lepi shemmin hassetam haya kebar hechametz betok hammayim keshennatelu mehem lebashshel hattabshil, shekkol haissurin anu danin otan kishat metziatan lemaprea, dehaynu kesheanu motzein issur bemaqom echad — anu machaziqin issur bammaqom hazzeh lemaprea, veomerim: kan nimtza haissur akshav, vekan haya kebar qodem laken. Veen zeh niqra sapeq, ella leinyan shekkesheyyesh sham od sapeq echad — hare zeh niqra sepeq sepeqa. Umikkol maqom, im nitareb mashshehu mittabshil zeh betabshil acher — yesh lehattir oto tabshil apillu baakila im yesh sham hepsed merubbeh umeniat simchat yom tob:

Veken basar shennishra bachammin hallalu qodem shennimtza bahem hechametz — asur apillu lehashhoto. Veim nimtza bahem chitta sheenah bequa — yesh lehattir habbasar apillu baakila, kemo shennitbaer. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veoserin habbasar shennishra bahem o hattabshil shebbishshelu bahem ap shennimtza bahem chitta sheenah bequa ella shennitrakkeka lepi minhag medinot ellu. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem im en sham hepsed merubbeh velo meniat simchat yom tob. Veap lepi dibrehem muttar limkor habbasar o hattabshil lenokri, dekevan sheyyesh kan sepeq sepeqa lehaqel kemo shennitbaer — en machamirin kol kak leesor ap hammekira lenokri, kevan sheyyesh mattirin ap hattabshil shennimtza bo chitta bequa:

Vekol zeh bibsar behema vechayya o apillu besar op ella shehachitta shennimtzet bammayim hi shelema, abal im nishra besar op bemayim chammin apillu bikli rishon uleachar shessillequhu mishsham matzeu sham chitta shebura, apillu hi bequa — yesh lehattir haop apillu baakila mikkoach sepeq sepeqa: shemma atta nopla hachitta sham leachar shessillequ haop mishsham, veim timtza lomar qodem laken hayeta sham, shemma haya chitta zo kebar bime haop venitakkel kebar bemeayv ad shennishbera, veshub en bah issur chametz kemo sheyyitbaer, umimmeayv nopla libsaro umibbesaro nopla letok hammayim shennimtzet bahem:

Chitta bequa shennimtzet bepesach beissa o bematztza apuya — yesh rotzim lehaqel lehattir kol hammatztza vehaissa, lepi shehachitta shennitbaqqea enah chametz gamur miyyad shennitbaqqea ella hi qeroba lehachmitz, vetekep umiyyad tabo lide chimmutz gamur, vechitta zo shennimtzet baissa o bammatztza bevadday adayin lo baa lide chimmutz, shehare min hassetam lo nopla letok haissa beshaa shehaya oseq bah belisha vaarika, shehare haya roeh otah umesirah, ella bevadday nopla letok haqqemach qodem hallisha, veaz bevadday lo hechmitza, kevan sheen sham mayim, vegam achar kak shennillosh haqqemach bemayim bevadday gam ken lo hechmitza hachitta, shehachitta hi qasha veenah memaheret lehachmitz kemo haissa, vekevan shehaissa lo hechmitza kol shekken hachitta. Veen chosheshin shemma hayeta hachitta kebar bequa qodem shennopla letok haqqemach, sheen machaziqin issur missapeq lomar shekkebar baa bammayim venitbaqqea qodem shennopla letok haqqemach, ella tolin shennitbaqqea mechamat hammayim shebbeissa zo shennimtzet bah, vekevan shehaissa lo nitchammetza gam hachitta lo nitchammetza. Veen chosheshin shemma hayeta chitta zo betok hammayim shellashu bahem haissa ukebar nitbaqqea sham betok hammayim qodem shebbaa leissa zo, lepi shergilin yisrael lishmor yapeh et hammayim shennishabu lelishat hammatztza shello yippol letokam shum dabar, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"h:

Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shetztzarik lehasir min haissa o mehammatztza kede netilat maqom, dehaynu sheyyasir bimqom maggaah shel hachitta berochab gudal mikkol sebiboteha, lepi sheyyesh lachosh shemma hayeta hachitta kebar bequa keshennopla letok haissa, veoseret et haissa bimqom maggaah. Veap lehaomerim shechametz bepesach eno oser betzonen, mikkol maqom al yede dochaq hallisha mitmatztzeh venischat mehachitta letok haissa kerochab gudal mikkol sebiboteha. Ulepi minhag medinot ellu haddin ken apillu im lo nitbaqqea hachitta ella shennitrakkeka. Veyesh omerim sheim nimtzet chitta bequa baissa, ulepi minhag medinot ellu apillu lo nitbaqqea ella shennitrakkeka — kol haissa asura, lepi shello bemaqom echad bilbad noga hachitta, ella kan vekan bimqomot harbeh derek gilgulah shel issa, ubekol maqom umaqom yesh chashash shemma nischat lesham mashshehu mehachitta, ulepikak yesh leosrah kullah im hu betok happesach, shechametz bepesach bemashshehu. Abal qodem happesach en tzarik lehasir mimmenna ella kede netilat maqom bilbad. Veap im nimtzet bah leachar apiyyatah, day bintilat maqom bilbad (ayyen siman ts"a). Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kassebara haacharona. Veken nohagin. Umikkol maqom, behepsed merubbeh o sheat haddechaq yesh lismok al sebara hashsheniyya. Veap betok happesach day bintilat maqom, kevan sheyyesh omerim sheap netilat maqom en tzarik:

Veim chatak issa achat gedola lematztzot harbeh venimtzet chitta bequa beachat min hammatztzot, ben shennimtzet bah leachar apiyyatah, ben shennimtzet bah beodah batzeq — hi asura im nillosha bah hachitta betok happesach, ushear hammatztzot muttarot. Veen chosheshin shemma hayeta chitta zo betok haissa haggedola veneesra kullah, ella tolin lehaqel lomar: leachar shennechteka mimmenna hammatztza nopla hachitta letok matztza achat mehen, lepi sheanu omerim: kan nimtzet hachitta akshav bematztza zo — kan hayeta battechilla keshennopla, velo nopla meolam letok issa haggedola, sheen machaziqin issur mimmaqom lemaqom:

Veim hachitta hi melea mayim umeluchlechet meeber el eber, im ken nireh shehayeta bammayim ubaissa haggedola, laken yesh leesor kol hammatztzot. Umikkol maqom, im yesh litlot shehayeta bemaqom acher belua mimmayim venopla akshav letok matztza zo — tolin lehaqel im yesh bemah litlot (shelleolam tolin bammatzuy, ben lehaqel ben lehachamir, veeno niqra sapeq ella kesheyyesh litlot bazeh kemo bazeh, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea):

Abal machaziqin issur mizzeman lizman bemaqom echad, kegon mi shechatak issa gedola lematztzot harbeh vechilleqan libne adam harbeh venitpazzeru ish limqomo laasotan umatztza achat hotir beyado beoto maqom shechatak et haissa venimtzet bah chitta — kullam asurot, sheanu chosheshin shemma hayeta bah hachitta qodem laken, keshehayu adayin kol hammatztzot mechubbarot immah qodem shennechteku mimmenna, veneesru kullam. Umikkol maqom, im en hachitta bequa, ap al pi shennitrakkeka — yesh lehattir limkor shear hammatztzot lenokri, kevan sheyyesh kan harbeh tzedadim lehaqel: shemma lo nitchammetza hachitta, veshemma nopla shamma leachar shennechteku shear hammatztzot. Umikkol maqom, en zeh sepeq sepeqa gamur lehattiram ap baakila, lepi shehassapeq shemma lo nitchammetza hu sapeq mechamat chesron yedia, dekevan shennitrakkeka en anu beqiin im hi reuya lehitbaqqea im lav kemo shennitbaer lemala, vekol sapeq shehu mechamat chesron yedia — eno niqra sapeq kelal kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea, veeno moil ella lehattir hamkira lenokri, lepi sheyyesh mattirin apillu bechitta bequa:

Veken kerub maliach hakkabush bechabit venatal meat tzir min hechabit letok haqqeara venimtzet chitta bequa baqqeara — hakkerub shebbechabit muttar, sheanu tolin shelletok haqqeara nopla velo hayeta meolam bechabit, sheen machaziqin issur mimmaqom lemaqom. Abal im nimtzet chitta bequa bechabit leachar shennatan mimmenna letok haqqeara — gam hakkerub shebbaqqeara asur, shemmachaziqin issur mizzeman lizman, veshemma hayeta hachitta bechabit qodem shennatenu mimmenna laqqeara, veneesar az kol mah shebbechabit ap lehaomerim shechametz bepesach eno oser betzonen, sheyyesh lachosh shemma nikbesha hachitta meet leet betok hechabit, vekol hakkabush meet leet — hare hu kimbushshal. Veen lehattir mah shebbaqqeara mikkoach sepeq sepeqa, shemma atta nopla hachitta letok hechabit leachar shekkebar natan mimmenna letok haqqeara, veim timtza lomar qodem laken nopla shemma lo shahata shamma meet leet, dekevan shemmachaziqin issur mizzeman lizman, anu omerim shechitta zo shennimtzet atta bechabit kebar hayeta sham bechabit mizzeman merubbeh yoter mimmeet leet, umimmela neesar gam mah shennatenu mimmenna letok haqqeara betok zeh hazzeman, veen kan sepeq sepeqa kelal:

Vekol zeh keshehachitta mebuqqaat, abal im lo nitbaqqea hachitta — yesh lehattir mah shebbechabit im yesh sham hepsed merubbeh, mikkoach sepeq sepeqa: shemma nopla sham tok meet leet, veim timtza lomar nopla qodem laken, shemma lo nitrakkeka ad tok meet leet:
Vekol zeh keshennimtza hachitta betok hatztzir shebbechabit, abal im nimtza al gabbe chatikat kerub veen hatztzir oleh al gabbah — en bah din kabush kelal, ella din maliach sheyyitbaer:

Mi shepparas chatikat matztza qetanna mechatikat matztza gedola unetanah letok piv, venatal chatikat basar qetanna mehabbasar tzonen hammunnach lepanayv unetanah gam ken letok piv uleasan yachad, vehirgish bepiv sheyyesh sham chitta, venatal hammaakal mippiv veraa sham chitta bequa, veen nikkar im hayeta bammatztza o babbasar — yesh lehattir habbasar shennishar munnach lepanayv, sheanu tolin shennopla hachitta alayv leachar shehinnicho lepanayv, veaz haya tzonen, vetzonen yabesh belo roteb eno oser ledibre hakkol. Veen chosheshin shemma nopla alayv beodo roteach baqqedera o baqqeara, sheen machaziqin issur mimmaqom lemaqom, vegam chatikat matztza haggedola yesh lehattir ap al pi sheyyesh lachosh shemma hayeta hachitta betok hammatztza bepiv, ubevadday lo nopla aleha leachar haapiyya, shehare hayeta mitgalgelet veyoredet, ella nopla aleha qodem apiyyatah bishat lishatah, veneeseret kol hammatztza im neepet betok happesach shechametz bepesach bemashshehu (ayyen siman ts"a). Mikkol maqom, kevan sheissur mashshehu eno ella middibre soperim — tolin lehaqel shello hayeta hachitta meolam betok hammatztza ella betok habbasar leachar shennitztannen, ushenehem muttarim. Umikkol maqom, tzarik lehasir kede netilat maqom mechatikat matztza haggedola beoto maqom shepparas mimmenna hachatika qetanna, sheyyesh lachosh shemma hayeta hachitta beoto maqom veneesar sham kede netilat maqom min hammatztza, lepi shenniplat taam hachitta lesham, vetaam hu keiqqar min hattora, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman tz"ch:

Vekol zeh keshehabbasar hammunnach lepanayv haya tzonen kebar keshehinnicho bemaqom zeh, abal im hinnicho lepanayv keshehu roteach baqqeara shehu keli sheni — asur (o apillu lo haya sham roteb lepi minhag medinot ellu, kemo sheyyitbaer), shehare machaziqin issur mizzeman lizman. Veen lehattir mikkoach sepeq sepeqa: shemma chitta zo hayeta bammatztza shebbepiv, veim timtza lomar babbasar shemma nopla alayv leachar shennitztannen, sheim ken, tzarik atta leesor et hammatztza qodem shettattir et habbasar, uma raita lehattir habbasar velomar shehachitta hayeta bammatztza veleesor hammatztza? Shemma hayeta babbasar vehammatztza mutteret, shekkol sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Veim tattir et hammatztza i epshar lehattir et habbasar, lepi sheen bo ella sapeq echad lehaqel, dehaynu shemma nopla alayv leachar shennitztannen, veen meqillin missapeq zeh bilbad, kevan shehu bemaqom echad mizzeman lizman, vekevan shei epshar leka lehattir shenehem, shehare bevadday hayeta hachitta beechad mehem — tzarik atta leesor shenehem:

Vekol zeh bibsar behema vechayya, o apillu bibsar op ella shehachitta hi shelema, abal im hu besar op vehachitta hi shebura — yesh lehattir habbasar mikkoach sepeq sepeqa: shemma nopla alayv leachar shennitztannen, veim timtza lomar qodem laken, shemma hayeta kebar bime haop venitakkela sham bemeayv ad shennishbera, veshub en bah issur chametz, umimmeayv nidbeqa libsaro, vekevan shehabbasar muttar — yesh lehattir gam hammatztza, sheanu tolin shehachitta nopla letok habbasar leachar shennitztannen, o shennitakkela kebar bemeayv, ulepikak shenehem muttarim, shekkol sepeq dibre soperim lehaqel. Raq sheyyasir kede netila mehammatztza, abal mehabbasar en tzarik lehasir kelum, kevan sheyyesh bo sepeq sepeqa, vekol sepeq sepeqa moil apillu beissur shel tora:

Im higilu yora mechummetzet qodem happesach veshapeku me hagala hamchummatzim veyaredu lebor betok happesach — neesru hammayim shebbabbor ap lehaomerim shechametz bepesach eno oser betzonen, shello ameru ken ella keshehesir mammashut hechametz mehatztzonen, sheen tamo niplat betzonen, abal kan hammayim hamchummatzin hen meorabin bememe habbor, veen mitbattelin betoko beshishshim, kevan shennitarebu bahem betok happesach. Abal im yaredu labbor qodem happesach venitbattelu sham beshishshim — muttarin. Umikkol maqom, im yesh lachosh shemme hagala enan mitorbin yapeh bememe habbor ella hem niqvim veomedim lemala — asur lishob mehabbor bepesach, ella im ken kebar shaab mimmennu peamim rabbot qodem happesach leachar sheyyaredu lesham me hagala, sheal yede hashsheiba mitorbim yapeh me hagala bememe habbor umitbattelim bahem beshishshim qodem happesach. Veim lo shaab mimmennu kelum qodem happesach veshaab mimmennu mayim bepesach ubishshel bahem tabshil — yesh lehattir hattabshil, shebbevadday yesh shishshim bammayim hallalu keneged meat me hagala shennitarebu betokam al yede hashsheiba, ume hagala enan oserin bemashshehu, kevan sheen bahem chashash chimmutz ella mechamat shehurtechu beyora mechummetzet, vahare yesh bahem noten taam ben noten taam shel hetter (ayyen siman tm"z). Vekol zeh keshehayyora hayeta bat yoma mibbeliat chametz beshaa shehigiluha, abal im lo hayeta bat yoma, ap im yaredu me hagala labbor betok happesach veen beme habbor shishshim kenegdam — muttar lishtot mehabbor bepesach ap im lo nitarebu yapeh me hahagala beme habbor, dekevan shehayyora lo hayeta bat yoma — hare hechametz habbalua bah noten taam lipgam beme hagala, vekol noten taam lipgam shennaasa qodem happesach — eno chozer veneor bepesach. (Umikkol maqom, qodem shennapelu me hagala letok me habbor — asur lehishtammesh beme hagala ap shehechametz haya noten taam lipgam bahem, mittaam shennitbaer besiman tn"b):

Im nimtzet chitta bequa biber bepesach — asur lishob od mayim mehabbeer kol yeme happesach ap lehaomerim shechametz bepesach eno oser betzonen, shemmikkol maqom yesh lachosh shemma nishret sham chitta meet leet. Abal im en hachitta bequa, ap al pi shennitrakkeka, im hu sheat haddechaq shei epshar limtzo mayim acherim ella al yede haddechaq — yesh lehattir mikkoach sepeq sepeqa ap bimqomot shennohagin lehachamir betzonen bepesach, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Veim nimtzet perusat lechem o issa babbeer, apillu im yadua shello nishtaha sham meet leet, vehu maqom shello nahagu lehachamir betzonen — en lehishtammesh beme habbeer ella al yede sinnun apillu nimtzeu qodem happesach, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Mi sherotzeh lishob bepesach mibbeerot shel nokrim, o mibbeerot shel yisrael shello nizhar bahen mechametz kol hashshana — tob sheyyesannen hammayim bebeged naqi bekol paam sheshshoeb. Abal meiqqar haddin en machaziqin issur missapeq:

Basar chay shennimtza alayv chitta bequa qodem melichato, im hachitta hi menuggebet vegam habbasar hu menuggab bammaqom shennoga bo hachitta — apillu hadacha en tzarik. Abal im echad mehem lach qetzat bimqom negiatan — tzarik lehadiach habbasar bammaqom shennoga bo hachitta, veday lo bahadacha shemmedicho qodem hammelicha lehakshiro middamo. Veim nimtzet alayv chitta leachar shehudach qodem hammelicha — tzarik lachazor ulehadicho qodem hammelicha bammaqom shennoga bo hachitta. Veen lo lismok al hahadacha shemmedicho achar hammelicha, lepi sheoto mashshehu lachluchit shennaga bachitta shetztzarik lehaabiro mehabbasar al yede hadacha, im lo yaabirennu qodem hammelicha — hare hu nibla babbasar al yede hammelicha. Veap bimqomot shennohagin lehachamir betzonen bepesach — day lo bahadacha, kevan sheen bo bimqom hachitta ella qetzat lachluchit, velo hechemiru ella kesheyyesh sham roteb harbeh vehechametz hu nishreh betok haroteb, sheaz niplat taam mashshehu mehechametz letok haroteb veharoteb mablia oto taam mashshehu betok hahetter:

Veim nimtzet alayv hachitta leachar shennimlach beod shehammelach alayv — tzarik littol mimmennu kede qelipa bimqom maggaah shel hachitta im yadua beberur shello noga bo ella bammaqom shennimtzet bo. Abal im yesh lehistappeq shemma noga bo bemaqom acher — tzarik littol kede qelipa mikkullo, lepi shemmin hassetam kebar hayeta alayv hachitta beshaa shemmelacho, shehare machaziqin issur mizzeman lizman, umin hassetam napal qetzat melach gam al hachitta, vederek hammelach lehaplit tzir middabar hammaluach, vehatztzir shehiplit mehachitta nibla babbasar bimqom maggaah shel hachitta lepi shehu keroteach:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehabbasar hu kachush, abal im hu shamen bimqom maggaah shel hachitta — hare kol otah hachatika shennimtzet hachitta aleha asura apillu lehashhotah o lemokrah lenokri, lepi sheshshamnunit habbasar mepattem et hatztzir hannibla bo venaaseh keillu hu atzmo shamen, vaazay hu mepapea umitpashshet venibla bekol otah hachatika, shekken derek hashshumman lepapea keshehu roteach, vehatztzir hu keroteach. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim sheen koach beshamnunit habbasar lepattem et hatztzir hannibla, kevan shehashshamnunit hu tzonen, veap shehu maluach vehammaluach dino keroteach, mikkol maqom eno keroteach mammash leinyan zeh sheyyehe bo koach lepattem et hatztzir hannibla bo. Veken iqqar. Umikkol maqom, im en hepsed merubbeh velo meniat simchat yom tob — yesh lachosh lassebara harishona shello leoklo bepesach. Abal yakol lehashhoto leachar shehesir mimmenna kede qelipa o lemokro lenokri. Veakshav sheen anu beqiin ben basar kachush leshamen kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z, ap im otah chatika shennimtzet hachitta aleha hi kechusha kullah — en leoklah bepesach apillu im en hachitta bequa ella shennitrakkeka, ella im ken yesh sham hepsed merubbeh, kegon shehu ani vehi chatika gedola vachashuba, o sheyyesh sham meniat simchat yom tob, sheaz yesh lehattirah leachar sheyyasir kede qelipa:

Vekol zeh beotah chatika atzmah shennimtzet hachitta aleha, abal shear hachatikot shennimlechu immah beyachad, ap al pi shehayu nogeot bah venibla bahen hatztzir hayyotze mimmenna — enan neesarot kelal apillu im hen shemenot, vegam otah chatika hi shemena, lepi sheap lehaomerim sheshshamnunit habbasar mepattem et hatztzir hayyotze mehachitta, mikkol maqom en betzir zeh koach lepapea mechatika lachatika belo roteb, kevan sheeno shamen mitztzad atzmo, venimtza sheen bishar hachatikot apillu mashshehu mitztzir zeh sheyyatza mehachitta:

Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim: kevan shebbekol issure tora shennimlechu im hahetter ap al pi shehaissur vehahetter hem kechushim ap al pi ken anu machamirin leesor ad shishshim apillu hen chatikot harbeh nogeot zo bazo vehaissur eno nogea ella beechad mehen bilbad, vehattaam hu kede shello nitztarek lehabchin lechalleq ben issur kachush leissur shamen, shebbeissur shamen min haddin yesh lehachamir ad shishshim apillu hen chatikot harbeh, lepi shehaissur atzmo mepapea mechatika lachatika kevan shehu shamen mitztzad atzmo, im ken bechametz bepesach sheeno mitbattel beshishshim — yesh lehachamir leesor kol chatikot shennimlechu immah yachad ap al pi shehu issur kachush. Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem im en sham hepsed kelal kesheyyashheh otan ad leachar happesach o sheyyimkerem lenokri. Abal im yesh sham hepsed qetzat o qetzat sheat haddechaq, vehachitta enah bequa ella shennitrakkeka — yesh lismok al sebara harishona, ki ken iqqar. Sheen anu machamirin bishar issurin leshaer beshishshim bimlicha apillu beissur kachush, ella beissur sheshshayyak bo qetzat shamnunit, kegon besar terepa kechusha shennimlach im hetter, sheyyesh terepa kechusha veyesh terepa shemena, lepikak anu machamirin bekol terepa apillu kechusha, kede shello nitztarek lehabchin ulechalleq ben kechusha lishmena, sheen anu beqiin bazeh, abal issur shelleolam hu kachush veen shayyak bo shamnunit kelal, kegon chametz bepesach — en lehachamir bo kemo beissur shamen ben leinyan melicha ben leinyan tzali, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Vekol zeh kesheyyadua beberur shello noga hachitta ella beotah chatika shennimtzet aleha, kegon shennimtzet tok tarnegolet, abal im yesh lehistappeq shemma noga gam bishar hachatikot, kegon shennimtzet al hattarnegolet mibbachutz o al shear basar — hare kullan tzerikot qelipa meiqqar haddin. Vaapillu im yadua beberur shello noga ella beachat mishshear hachatikot veen yadua ezo hi — enah mitbattelet betokan berob, kevan shehu betok happesach, ulepikak kullan tzerikot qelipa missapeq. Veim hen shemenot — kullan asurot, ella im ken yesh sham hepsed merubbeh o meniat simchat yom tob. Veakshav sheen anu beqiin ben kachush leshamen, ap im hem kechushot dinam kishmenot. Veim abar ubishshelam belo qelipa — yesh leesor kol hattabshil baakila, apillu yesh sham hepsed merubbeh umeniat simchat yom tob. Abal muttar lehashhotan o lemokran lenokri apillu lekattechilla belo qelipa, kevan sheen bahen ella sepeq negia:

Vekol zeh keshennimtzet hachitta al habbasar qodem shehudach achar hammelicha, abal im nimtzet alayv leachar shehudach — bevadday akshav nopla alayv velo hayeta alayv bishat melichato, umediach meqom maggaah veday, sheim hayeta alayv bishat melichato — hayeta oberet mealayv al yede hadacha. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennimtzet al gabbe habbasar o al gabbe hattarnegolet, abal im nimtzet betok hattarnegolet — bevadday hayeta sham bishat melicha, shehare bevadday lo nopla mimmaqom acher letok hattarnegolet, ella hayeta sham bemeeha umimmeeha nopla sham al besarah:

Vekol zeh keshennimtzet hachitta munnachat babbasar, vehu haddin bedagim, abal im nimtzet nishret betok tzir hayyotze mibbasar o dagim bishat melichatan — hare kol hachatikot hammunnachot betok hatztzir, apillu hen kechushot — kullan asurot apillu lehashhotan o lemokran lenokri im shahata hachitta im hachatikot betok hatztzir bikde sheim haya noten hatztzir bikli al haesh haya matchil lehartiach ulehitbashshel, dekevan sheshshahu betoko keshiur bishshul — hare hen keillu nitbashshelu mammash betoko. Umikkol maqom, im en hachitta mebuqqaat — yesh lehattir lehashhotan o lemokran lenokri im yesh sham hepsed merubbeh, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Veim miqtzat hachatika betok hatztzir umiqtzatah lemala min hatztzir — hammiqtzat shebbetok hatztzir asur apillu lehashhotah o lemokrah apillu bimqom hepsed merubbeh, vehammiqtzat shellemala min hatztzir muttar lehashhotah o lemokrah apillu im en sham hepsed merubbeh. Raq sheyyizzaher lehasir mimmenna kede qelipa bammaqom shehaya mechubbar lemiqtzat hab' shebbetok hatztzir. Veim yesh sham hepsed merubbeh umeniat simchat yom tob — yesh lehattiro apillu baakila:

Im nishar meat shekar bikli venatelu betoko mayim vehedichu bahen basar achar melichato bepesach — yesh lehattir habbasar ap belo qelipa meiqqar haddin, sheap shehammayim neesru mechamat hashshekar shennitareb betokam, mikkol maqom habbasar lo bala kelum mimmayim hallalu, kevan shehu tzonen, sheap hammachamirin bepesach betzonen — lo hechemiru ella keshennishra haissur betok hetter tzonen o shennishra hahetter betok issur tzonen o shennishra haissur vehahetter betok roteb tzonen, abal kan shehaissur abar al hahetter derek haabara beolma — lo neesar kelal betzonen ledibre hakkol. Veap al pi shehabbasar haya maluach adayin beshaa shehedicho, vehammaluach hu keroteach, mikkol maqom, lo bala kelum mimmayim hallalu, lepi shemmiyyad shehiggiu alayv hammayim — nitbattel retichato, ki hammayim shehedichu bahem hem mebattelim koach hammelach, veen lo koach lehablia hammayim babbasar. Umikkol maqom, mechamat chumrat chametz bepesach — yesh liqlop meat habbasar bammaqom shennageu bo hammayim hallalu, vehi chumra beolma:

Im nimtzet chitta bequa bepesach betarnegolet tzeluya o bishar basar tzali — tzarik lehasir meqom pipuah lepi omed haddaat. Umin hassetam enah oseret yoter mikkede qelipa, shehachitta hi qetanna ukechusha upelitatah muetet. Bammeh debarim amurim? Betzali kachush, abal im hu shamen bimqom maggaah shel hachitta — kullo asur apillu lehashhoto o lemokro. Veakshav sheen anu beqiin ben kachush leshamen — ap im hu kachush yesh leesor kullo, ap im lo nitbaqqea hachitta, ella shennitrakkeka. Umikkol maqom, behepsed merubbeh o bimqom meniat simchat yom tob — yesh lismok al beqiutenu im hu kachush lehattiro apillu baakila leachar sheyyasir mimmennu kede qelipa, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman q"h:

Vekol zeh keshennitzla biqdera o al gabbe gechalim, abal im nitzla beshappud, apillu hu kachush legamre — kullo asur apillu lehashhoto o lemokro lenokri, lepi keshemmehappekim hashshappud mitpashshet taam mashshehu mehachitta bekol hatztzali. Veim nitzlu tarnegolot harbeh al shappud echad bebat achat vehen nogeot zo bazo venimtzet chitta al achat mehen — kullan asurot apillu hen kechushot, lepi sheal yede hippuk hashshappud mitpashshet hattaam mashshehu mizzo lazo umizzo lazo. Abal im enan nogeot zo bazo — muttarot. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehattarnegolet shennimtzet hachitta aleha hi kechusha, abal im hi shemena — hare hashshumman mepattem et taam mashshehu chametz habbalua betoko, veal yede hashshappud mepapea umitpashshet taam mashshehu zeh venibla bekol orek hashshappud veoser et kol tarnegolot hatztzeluyot bashshappud. Umikkol maqom, im en hachitta mebuqqaat — yesh lehattir bimqom hepsed merubbeh limkor lenokri o lehashhot apillu hattarnegolet shennimtzet hachitta aleha, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Im nimtzea chitta o seora bequa bepesach bezepeq haop leachar shehibhabu oto baur lehasir notzat haop — muttar, shehare hachitta enah oseret apillu betzali mammash yoter mikkede qelipa, vekan hazzepeq hu haqqelippa shemmesirin umashlikin oto. Vaapillu im haop shamen — en lehachamir bo yoter mikkede qelipa, ki hahibhub eno domeh kelal letzali, hoil veeno mehabhebo harbeh bemaqom echad, ella maabiro tamid henna vahenna, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman s"ch:

Veotah hachitta shennimtzet bazzepeq — tzarik lesorpah apillu lo nitbaqqea ella shennitrakkeka. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehi shelema, abal im hi shebura — hare nikkar sheshshalat bah haikkul ad shennishtabbera, vahare zo keperesh venipqa issur chametz mimmenna, veen tzarik lebaarah. Veen tzarik lomar sheenah oseret apillu kede qelipa:

Vekol zeh bechitta useora vekayyotze bahen middebarim sheepshar shebbelaan haop keshehen shelemim velo leasan kelal, ulekak enan chashubim kimukkalim ad shennishtabberu sham bemeayv. Abal im akal mursan vekayyotze bo middebarim rakkim shebbevadday nilasu bepiv, im shahu bemeayv keshiur ikkul, dehaynu meet leet — hare hem kimukkalim legamre venipqa mehem issur chametz. Veim heqian derek bet harei, apillu betok meet leet — nipqa mehem issur chametz. Abal im bala chittim useorim vekayyotze bahen veheqian keshehen shelemim, ap sheshshahu bemeayv yoter mimmeet leet — lo nipqa issuran. Veken im bala shear issurin — dino kechametz bepesach leinyan zeh:
Kol maqom shemmeqillin mechamat hepsed merubbeh, im yakol lehashhot ad leachar happesach o limkor lenokri bepesach velo yihyeh sham hepsed merubbeh — en lehaqel:
Kol maqom shemmeqillin mechamat simchat yom tob — yesh lehaqel apillu bechullo shel moed, sheap hu biklal yom tob leinyan simcha, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqk"t:
